description: This source file implements SPNEGO/Negotiate authentication using Windows SSPI for libcurl. It contains functions to check support, decode challenge messages, create response messages, and cleanup related resources, specifically targeting Windows SSPI APIs for security token handling.

methods.name: bool Curl_auth_is_spnego_supported(void)
methods.description: Checks if SPNEGO (Negotiate) authentication is supported by the Windows SSPI security package.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_decode_spnego_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * user,const char * password,const char * service,const char * host,const char * chlg64,struct negotiatedata * nego)
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded SPNEGO challenge message and initializes the security context for authentication.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_spnego_message(struct negotiatedata * nego,char ** outptr,size_t * outlen)
methods.description: Encodes the generated security token into base64 to be sent as a SPNEGO message.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_cleanup_spnego(struct negotiatedata * nego)
methods.description: Cleans up all SPNEGO/Negotiate specific security context, credentials, and allocated resources.
